removed.name: alsa
removed.desc: Hardware soundcard I/O. Incompatible with Docker/AFL++ execution environments.

removed.name: sdl2
removed.desc: Desktop GUI rendering library. Incompatible with headless Docker fuzzing environments.

removed.name: avcodec
removed.desc: Core audio/video codec library. Disabling this completely prevents the ffmpeg CLI executable from being built.

removed.name: avfilter
removed.desc: Audio and video filtering framework. The ffmpeg CLI tool relies heavily on this to process streams and will fail to generate without it.

removed.name: swresample
removed.desc: Software audio resampling library. Required by avfilter for handling audio conversions, making it an essential dependency for the CLI tool.

removed.name: avformat
removed.desc: Core muxing/demuxing library. The ffmpeg CLI tool will not build without it.

removed.name: avdevice
removed.desc: Device handling library. The ffmpeg CLI tool relies on this and will silently fail to build if disabled.

removed.name: swscale
removed.desc: Video scaling and pixel format conversion library. Essential for the ffmpeg CLI tool.

removed.name: static
removed.desc: Must remain enabled. The build.sh script explicitly passes static linking flags to the linker (-static). Disabling this causes linker failures.

removed.name: shared
removed.desc: Should remain disabled to prevent conflicts with the static linking requirements of the fuzzing harness.

removed.name: pthreads
removed.desc: Must remain enabled. The ffmpeg CLI tool relies heavily on threading and will silently skip building if pthreads are disabled.
